disableDates.description: Which side is muted/non-clickable. 'past' mutes dates before minDate (default today; Booking.com style, range builds forward). 'future' mutes dates after maxDate (default today; range builds backward). 'none' mutes nothing (pick any two dates either direction).

minDate.description: Earliest selectable date as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Hard lower bound regardless of disableDates.

maxDate.description: Latest selectable date as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Hard upper bound regardless of disableDates.

shortSpanHours.description: Threshold (hours) at which durationLabel flips from elapsed time (below) to whole days (at or above).

timeStepSeconds.description: Granularity (seconds) of the time selectors. 1 allows down-to-the-second selection.

firstDayMonday.description: Start weeks on Monday (true) or Sunday (false).

compactBelowHeight.description: When the component's rendered height (px) is below this, it switches from the full calendar to a compact two-field (start/end date + time) layout.

startDate.description: Selected start date (date only, 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Two-way: set it to pre-select.

startTimeSec.description: Start time as seconds since midnight (0 = 00:00:00).

endTimeSec.description: End time as seconds since midnight (86399 = 23:59:59).

startDateTime.description: OUTPUT: start date + start time, local wall-clock ISO 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss'.

endDateTime.description: OUTPUT: end date + end time, local wall-clock ISO 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss'.

days.description: OUTPUT: whole calendar days between start and end (0 = same day).

durationHours.description: OUTPUT: full span in hours (endDateTime - startDateTime).

durationLabel.description: OUTPUT: pre-formatted span for display, e.g. '3 days' or '6h 30m'.

isValid.description: OUTPUT: true when both endpoints are set and endDateTime > startDateTime.
